correctness.rationale: The first-arrival recursion is an exact induction over all induced vertex subsets. For the displayed proper bare KC shift, exact recurrence yields 73/15 and 34/7, with reversal -1/105. The proof of first possible order enumerates all labeled trees by Prüfer codes through n=8, deduplicates by a complete tree-isomorphism encoding, and checks all 146 proper KC bare paths, each giving a positive rational difference. Independent direct enumeration of all 362880 permutations on both witness trees reproduces their distributions. These are finite exhaustive computations, not simulations or infinite theorems.

An exact counterexample and proved first order are not consequences of the proven global path-minimality result. residual_risks: Unindexed, recently revised or inaccessible publications could already exhibit the same finite KC reversal.

value.rationale: This is the sharp minimal counterexample to a natural and explicitly suggested local monotonicity principle used to motivate a proved global extremal theorem. The finding separates an actual stochastic observable from an auxiliary monotone proxy, and gives a natural exact size cutoff with reproducible finite proof; it is not an arbitrary small numerical improvement.
